hints.title: Longest Alternating Subsequence
hints.text: Finding the minimum deletions to leave an alternating sequence is equivalent to finding the length of the longest alternating subsequence and subtracting it from the total length.

hints.title: Greedy Character Transitions
hints.text: In a maximal alternating subsequence, you keep the first character and thereafter pick each character that differs from the most recently kept character.

hints.title: Compute Deletions
hints.text: Count the number of transitions where adjacent characters differ. The maximal alternating length is 1 + transitions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subsequences takes exponential O(2^n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy transition counting uses constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects realizing that maximal alternating subsequence matches adjacent inequality transitions.
